// scripts/run-agentes.mjs
import { readFile, readdir } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join, dirname } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import yaml from 'js-yaml';
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
import { geminiClient } from '../clients/gemini.js';
import { googlePlacesClient } from '../clients/googlePlaces.js';
import { hunterClient } from '../clients/hunter.js';
import { firecrawlClient } from '../clients/firecrawl.js';

// Inicializar Prisma
const prisma = new PrismaClient();
const __dirname = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

// Cargar el roster YAML
const rosterPath = join(__dirname, '..', 'config', 'roster.yaml');
const roster = yaml.load(await readFile(rosterPath, 'utf8'));

// Mapeo de acciones por agente
const agentActions = {
  'prospeccion': prospeccionAction,
  'enriquecimiento': enriquecimientoAction,
  'analista-web': analistaWebAction,
  'copywriter': copywriterAction,
  // Añadir más acciones según sea necesario
};

/**
 * Carga la ficha de un agente desde su carpeta
 */
async function loadAgentSlug(slug) {
  const [department, name] = slug.split('/');
  const agentDir = join(__dirname, '..', 'agentes', department, name);

  try {
    const files = await readdir(agentDir);
    const agent = {};

    for (const file of files) {
      if (file.endsWith('.md')) {
        const content = await readFile(join(agentDir, file), 'utf8');
        agent[file.replace('.md', '')] = content;
      }
    }

    return {
      slug,
      department,
      name,
      ...agent,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`❌ No se encontró el agente ${slug}:`, error.message);
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Ejecuta una acción de un agente
 */
async function executeAgent(agent, task) {
  const action = agentActions[agent.department] || defaultAction;
  const context = {
    prisma,
    gemini: geminiClient,
    googlePlaces: googlePlacesClient,
    hunter: hunterClient,
    firecrawl: firecrawlClient,
    log: (message) => console.log(`[${agent.slug}] ${message}`),
  };

  try {
    const result = await action(agent, task.input, context);
    return { success: true, data: result };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`❌ Error en ${agent.slug}:`, error.message);
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

/**
 * Acción por defecto (si no hay una específica)
 */
async function defaultAction(agent, input, context) {
  const prompt = `
    Eres el agente "${agent.name}" del departamento "${agent.department}".
    Tu identidad: ${agent.identidad}
    Tu proceso: ${agent.proceso}
    Tu skill: ${agent.skill}

    Tarea: ${JSON.stringify(input, null, 2)}

    Ejecuta la tarea y devuelve el resultado en JSON.
  `;

  const response = await context.gemini.generateContent(prompt);
  return JSON.parse(response || '{}');
}

/**
 * Acción para el agente de Prospección
 */
async function prospeccionAction(agent, input, context) {
  const { industry, location, limit = 10 } = input;

  context.log(`Buscando ${limit} empresas de ${industry} en ${location}...`);

  // 1. Buscar en Google Places
  const companies = await context.googlePlaces.textSearch({
    query: `${industry} in ${location}`,
    radius: 50000,
  });

  // 2. Filtrar empresas con sitio web o teléfono
  const filtered = companies
    .filter(c => c.website || c.formatted_phone_number)
    .slice(0, limit);

  if (filtered.length === 0) {
    throw new Error(`No se encontraron empresas de ${industry} en ${location}`);
  }

  // 3. Guardar en Neon
  const createdCompanies = await Promise.all(
    filtered.map(async (c) => {
      return prisma.company.upsert({
        where: { placeId: c.place_id },
        create: {
          name: c.name,
          address: c.vicinity,
          website: c.website,
          phone: c.formatted_phone_number,
          placeId: c.place_id,
          latitude: c.geometry?.location?.lat,
          longitude: c.geometry?.location?.lng,
          status: "raw",
          industry,
          location,
        },
        update: {
          name: c.name,
          address: c.vicinity,
          website: c.website,
          phone: c.formatted_phone_number,
          latitude: c.geometry?.location?.lat,
          longitude: c.geometry?.location?.lng,
        },
      });
    })
  );

  return {
    companies: createdCompanies.map(c => ({
      id: c.id,
      name: c.name,
      website: c.website,
      phone: c.phone,
    })),
    count: createdCompanies.length,
  };
}

/**
 * Acción para el agente de Enriquecimiento
 */
async function enriquecimientoAction(agent, input, context) {
  const { leadId, companyName, website } = input;

  context.log(`Enriqueciendo lead ${leadId} (${companyName})...`);

  // 1. Buscar emails con Hunter.io
  let emails = [];
  try {
    const domain = new URL(website).hostname;
    const hunterResult = await context.hunter.findEmails({ domain, company: companyName });
    emails = hunterResult.emails?.map(e => e.value) || [];
  } catch (error) {
    context.log(`Hunter falló para ${website}: ${error.message}`);
  }

  // 2. Scrapear sitio web con Firecrawl
  let scrapedData = null;
  try {
    scrapedData = await context.firecrawl.scrape(website, {
      formats: ["markdown"],
    });
  } catch (error) {
    context.log(`Firecrawl falló para ${website}: ${error.message}`);
  }

  // 3. Buscar teléfonos en el sitio (regex)
  const phones = [];
  if (scrapedData?.markdown) {
    const phoneRegex = /(\+?\d{1,3}[-.\s]?)?\(?\d{3}\)?[-.\s]?\d{3}[-.\s]?\d{4}/g;
    const foundPhones = scrapedData.markdown.match(phoneRegex) || [];
    phones.push(...foundPhones.filter(p => !phones.includes(p)));
  }

  // 4. Buscar redes sociales
  const socialMedia = {};
  if (scrapedData?.markdown) {
    const socialLinks = scrapedData.markdown.match(/https?:\/\/(www\.)?(linkedin|twitter|facebook|instagram)\.com\/[a-zA-Z0-9(\-_@.)]+\/?/g) || [];
    socialLinks.forEach(link => {
      if (link.includes("linkedin")) socialMedia.linkedin = link;
      if (link.includes("twitter")) socialMedia.twitter = link;
      if (link.includes("facebook")) socialMedia.facebook = link;
      if (link.includes("instagram")) socialMedia.instagram = link;
    });
  }

  // 5. Calcular confidence score (0-100)
  let confidenceScore = 50;
  if (emails.length >= 1) confidenceScore += 20;
  if (phones.length >= 1) confidenceScore += 15;
  if (socialMedia.linkedin) confidenceScore += 10;
  if (scrapedData) confidenceScore += 15;

  // 6. Actualizar lead en Neon
  await prisma.company.update({
    where: { id: leadId },
    data: {
      emails,
      phones,
      socialMedia,
      scrapedData: scrapedData?.markdown,
      confidenceScore,
      status: "enriched",
      updatedAt: new Date(),
    },
  });

  return {
    emails,
    phones,
    socialMedia,
    confidenceScore,
  };
}

/**
 * Acción para el agente Analista Web
 */
async function analistaWebAction(agent, input, context) {
  const { leadId, website } = input;

  context.log(`Analizando sitio web de ${website}...`);

  // 1. Scrapear con Firecrawl
  const scrapedData = await context.firecrawl.scrape(website);

  // 2. Analizar con Lighthouse (opcional, requiere Node.js 18+)
  // const lighthouse = await context.lighthouse.analyze(website);

  // 3. Detectar tecnologías con Wappalyzer (simplificado)
  const technologies = [];
  if (scrapedData.markdown) {
    if (scrapedData.markdown.includes("WordPress")) technologies.push("WordPress");
    if (scrapedData.markdown.includes("Shopify")) technologies.push("Shopify");
    if (scrapedData.markdown.includes("React")) technologies.push("React");
  }

  // 4. Identificar oportunidades
  const oportunidades = [];
  if (!scrapedData.markdown.includes("chatbot")) {
    oportunidades.push("No tiene chatbot (opportunidad para automatización)");
  }
  if (scrapedData.markdown.includes("contacto@") && !scrapedData.markdown.includes("WhatsApp")) {
    oportunidades.push("Tiene email pero no WhatsApp (opportunidad para multicanal)");
  }

  // 5. Guardar diagnóstico en Neon
  await prisma.company.update({
    where: { id: leadId },
    data: {
      analysis: {
        technologies,
        oportunidades,
        contentLength: scrapedData.markdown?.length || 0,
      },
      status: "analyzed",
      updatedAt: new Date(),
    },
  });

  return {
    technologies,
    oportunidades,
    contentLength: scrapedData.markdown?.length || 0,
  };
}

/**
 * Acción para el agente Copywriter
 */
async function copywriterAction(agent, input, context) {
  const { leadId, companyName, industry, painPoints = [], valueProposition } = input;

  context.log(`Generando secuencia de outreach para ${companyName}...`);

  // 1. Generar prompt para Gemini
  const prompt = `
    Eres un experto en ventas B2B para la industria "${industry}".
    La empresa "${companyName}" tiene los siguientes puntos de dolor: ${painPoints.join(', ')}.
    Nuestra propuesta de valor es: "${valueProposition}".

    Genera:
    1. Una secuencia de 3 emails (asunto + cuerpo) para contactar a esta empresa.
       - Email 1: Presentación inicial (máx 150 palabras).
       - Email 2: Seguimiento (3 días después, máx 100 palabras).
       - Email 3: Último intento (7 días después, máx 100 palabras).
    2. Un mensaje para LinkedIn (máx 200 caracteres).
    3. Un mensaje para WhatsApp (máx 160 caracteres).
    4. Un guion de llamada (puntos clave para una llamada de 2 minutos).

    Formato de salida (JSON):
    {
      "emailSequence": [
        { "subject": "Asunto 1", "body": "Cuerpo 1", "delayDays": 0 },
        { "subject": "Asunto 2", "body": "Cuerpo 2", "delayDays": 3 },
        { "subject": "Asunto 3", "body": "Cuerpo 3", "delayDays": 7 }
      ],
      "linkedinMessage": "Mensaje para LinkedIn",
      "whatsappMessage": "Mensaje para WhatsApp",
      "callScript": "Guion de llamada"
    }
  `;

  // 2. Generar contenido con Gemini
  const response = await context.gemini.generateContent(prompt);

  try {
    const result = JSON.parse(response);
    return result;
  } catch (error) {
    // Si no es JSON válido, devolver el texto crudo
    return {
      emailSequence: [
        { subject: "Presentación", body: response, delayDays: 0 },
        { subject: "Seguimiento", body: response, delayDays: 3 },
        { subject: "Último intento", body: response, delayDays: 7 },
      ],
      linkedinMessage: response.substring(0, 200),
      whatsappMessage: response.substring(0, 160),
      callScript: response.substring(0, 500),
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Carga todos los agentes desde el roster
 */
async function loadAllAgents() {
  const agents = {};
  for (const [department, names] of Object.entries(roster)) {
    for (const name of names) {
      const slug = `${department}/${name}`;
      const agent = await loadAgentSlug(slug);
      if (agent) {
        agents[slug] = agent;
      }
    }
  }
  return agents;
}

/**
 * Ejecuta una tarea
 */
async function runTask(task) {
  const agent = await loadAgentSlug(task.agentSlug);
  if (!agent) {
    throw new Error(`Agente ${task.agentSlug} no encontrado`);
  }

  const execution = await prisma.agentExecution.create({
    data: {
      agentSlug: task.agentSlug,
      input: task.input,
      status: "in_progress",
    },
  });

  try {
    const result = await executeAgent(agent, task);
    await prisma.agentExecution.update({
      where: { id: execution.id },
      data: {
        output: result.data,
        status: "completed",
        tokensUsed: result.tokensUsed || 0,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      },
    });
    return { success: true, data: result.data, executionId: execution.id };
  } catch (error) {
    await prisma.agentExecution.update({
      where: { id: execution.id },
      data: {
        error: error.message,
        status: "failed",
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      },
    });
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Función principal
 */
async function main() {
  console.log("🚀 Iniciando sistema de agentes de Clientum...");

  // Cargar todos los agentes
  const agents = await loadAllAgents();
  console.log(`✅ ${Object.keys(agents).length} agentes cargados`);

  // Ejemplo: Ejecutar tarea de prospección
  const task = {
    agentSlug: "ventas/prospector", // Ajustar según el roster
    input: {
      industry: "distribuidoras de generadores",
      location: "Córdoba, Argentina",
      limit: 10,
    },
  };

  try {
    const result = await runTask(task);
    console.log("✅ Tarea completada:", result.data);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("❌ Error:", error.message);
  } finally {
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  }
}

// Ejecutar si se llamó directamente
if (import.meta.url === `file://${process.argv[1]}`) {
  main().catch(console.error);
}

// Exportar funciones para uso externo
export { runTask, loadAllAgents, loadAgentSlug };

// pages/api/cron.js (Next.js Pages Router)
import { runTask } from '../../scripts/run-agentes.mjs';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  if (req.method !== 'GET') {
    return res.status(405).json({ error: 'Method not allowed' });
  }

  try {
    // Ejecutar tareas programadas (ej: seguimientos)
    await runTask({
      agentSlug: 'ventas/seguimiento',
      input: { action: 'check_pending_followups' },
    });

    return res.status(200).json({ success: true });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error en Cron Job:', error);
    return res.status(500).json({ error: error.message });
  }
}

javascript

import * as Sentry from '@sentry/node';

  dsn: process.env.SENTRY_DSN,
  integrations: [new CaptureConsole({ levels: ['error'] })],
  tracesSampleRate: 1.0,
});





Agregar SENTRY_DSN a las Variables de Entorno.


10.2. Configurar Langfuse (opcional)


Instalar Langfuse SDK:
bash
Copiar

npm install langfuse





Inicializar Langfuse en run-agentes.mjs:
javascript
Copiar

import { Langfuse } from "langfuse";

const langfuse = new Langfuse({
  secretKey: process.env.LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY,
  publicKey: process.env.LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY,
  baseUrl: process.env.LANGFUSE_BASE_URL,
});





Agregar tracing a las ejecuciones:
javascript
Copiar

const trace = langfuse.trace({
  name: "agent_execution",
  input: task.input,
  metadata: { agentSlug: task.agentSlug },
});

try {
  const result = await executeAgent(agent, task);
  trace.success({ output: result.data });
} catch (error) {
  trace.error({ error: error.message });
  throw error;
}

Crear proyecto en Neon**\n1. **Ir a [Neon.tech](https://neon.tech/)** y hacer login con GitHub.\n2. **Hacer clic en \"New Project\"**.\n3. **Seleccionar:**\n   - **Name:** `clientum-ai`\n   - **Region:** `AWS US East (Ohio)` (o la que prefieras)\n4. **Hacer clic en \"Create Project\"**.\n5. **Copiar la `DATABASE_URL`** y pegarla en las **Secrets de Replit**.\n\n---\n\n### **3.2. Configurar Prisma**\n1. **Instalar Prisma** (si no está instalado):\n   ```bash\n   npm install prisma @prisma/client\n   ```\n\n2. **Inicializar Prisma**:\n   ```bash\n   npx prisma init\n   ```\n   *(Esto creará `prisma/schema.prisma` y `.env`)*\n\n3. **Editar `prisma/schema.prisma`**:\n   ```prisma\n   // prisma/schema.prisma\n   generator client {\n     provider = \"prisma-client-js\"\n   }\n\n   datasource db {\n     provider = \"postgresql\"\n     url      = env(\"DATABASE_URL\")\n   }\n\n   // Modelos de la base de datos\n   model Agent {\n     id          String   @id @default(cuid())\n     slug        String   @unique  // Ej: \"customer-success-asesor\"\n     department  String\n     name        String\n     identity    Json     // Contenido de identidad.md\n     memory      Json     // Contenido de memoria.md\n     process     Json     // Contenido de proceso.md\n     skill       Json     // Contenido de skill.md\n     createdAt   DateTime @default(now())\n     updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt\n   }\n\n   model AgentExecution {\n     id          String   @id @default(cuid())\n     agentSlug   String\n     agent       Agent    @relation(fields: [agentSlug], references: [slug])\n     input       Json\n     output      Json?\n     status      String   // \"pending\", \"in_progress\", \"completed\", \"failed\"\n     retries     Int      @default(0)\n     error       String?\n     tokensUsed  Int      @default(0)\n     costEstimate Float   @default(0)\n     createdAt   DateTime @default(now())\n     updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt\n   }\n\n   model Company {\n     id          String   @id @default(cuid())\n     name        String\n     address     String?\n     website     String?\n     phone       String?\n     emails      String[] // Array de emails\n     industry    String?\n     location    String?\n     placeId     String?  // Google Places ID\n     latitude    Float?\n     longitude   Float?\n     status      String   @default(\"raw\") // \"raw\", \"enriched\", \"analyzed\", \"contacted\"\n     confidenceScore Int  @default(0) // 0-100\n     createdAt   DateTime @default(now())\n     updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt\n   }\n\n   model Lead {\n     id          String   @id @default(cuid())\n     companyId   String\n     company     Company  @relation(fields: [companyId], references: [id])\n     name        String?\n     role        String?\n     email       String?\n     phone       String?\n     linkedin    String?\n     status      String   @default(\"new\") // \"new\", \"contacted\", \"meeting\", \"closed\", \"lost\"\n     score       Int      @default(0) // 0-100\n     createdAt   DateTime @default(now())\n     updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt\n   }\n\n   model Task {\n     id          String   @id @default(cuid())\n     agentSlug   String\n     agent       Agent    @relation(fields: [agentSlug], references: [slug])\n     input       Json\n     output      Json?\n     status      String   @default(\"pending\") // \"pending\", \"in_progress\", \"completed\", \"failed\"\n     retries     Int      @default(0)\n     error       String?\n     createdAt   DateTime @default(now())\n     updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt\n   }\n   ```\n\n4. **Aplicar el esquema a Neon**:\n   ```bash\n   npx prisma db push\n   ```\n\n5. **Generar el cliente de Prisma**:\n   ```bash\n   npx prisma generate\n   ```\n\n---\n\n---\n\n## **📌 PASO 4: CREAR LOS CLIENTES DE APIs**\n\n### **4.1. Crear la carpeta `clients/`**\n```bash\nmkdir -p clients\n```\n\n---\n\n### **4.2. Crear `clients/gemini.js`**\n```javascript\n// clients/gemini.js\nimport { GoogleGenerativeAI } from \"@google/generative-ai\";\n\nconst genAI = new GoogleGenerativeAI(process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY);\n\nexport const geminiClient = {\n  /**\n   * Genera contenido usando Gemini\n   * @param {string} prompt - El prompt para el modelo\n   * @param {object} options - Opciones adicionales (model, temperature, etc.)\n   * @returns {Promise\u003cstring\u003e} - Respuesta de texto\n   */\n  async generateContent(prompt, options = {}) {\n    const model = genAI.getGenerativeModel({\n      model: options.model || \"gemini-1.5-flash\",\n      generationConfig: {\n        temperature: options.temperature || 0.7,\n        maxOutputTokens: options.maxTokens || 2000,\n      },\n    });\n\n    const result = await model.generateContent(prompt);\n    return result.response.text();\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * Genera contenido con streaming\n   */\n  async generateContentStream(prompt, options = {}) {\n    const model = genAI.getGenerativeModel({\n      model: options.model || \"gemini-1.5-flash\",\n      generationConfig: {\n        temperature: options.temperature || 0.7,\n      },\n    });\n\n    const result = await model.generateContentStream(prompt);\n    return result.stream;\n  },\n};\n```\n\n---\n\n### **4.3. Crear `clients/googlePlaces.js`**\n```javascript\n// clients/googlePlaces.js\nimport axios from \"axios\";\n\nconst API_KEY = process.env.GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY;\nconst BASE_URL = \"https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/place\";\n\nexport const googlePlacesClient = {\n  /**\n   * Busca empresas por texto\n   * @param {object} params - Parámetros de búsqueda\n   * @param {string} params.query - Consulta de búsqueda (ej: \"distribuidoras de generadores\")\n   * @param {string} params.location - Ubicación (lat,lng)\n   * @param {number} params.radius - Radio en metros (máx 50000)\n   * @returns {Promise\u003cArray\u003e} - Lista de empresas\n   */\n  async textSearch({ query, location, radius = 50000 }) {\n    try {\n      const response = await axios.get(`${BASE_URL}/textsearch/json`, {\n        params: {\n          query,\n          location,\n          radius,\n          type: \"establishment\",\n          key: API_KEY,\n        },\n      });\n      return response.data.results || [];\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error en Google Places Text Search:\", error.message);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * Obtiene detalles de un lugar\n   */\n  async getPlaceDetails(placeId) {\n    try {\n      const response = await axios.get(`${BASE_URL}/details/json`, {\n        params: {\n          place_id: placeId,\n          key: API_KEY,\n        },\n      });\n      return response.data.result || null;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error en Google Places Details:\", error.message);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  },\n};\n```\n\n---\n\n### **4.4. Crear `clients/hunter.js`**\n```javascript\n// clients/hunter.js\nimport axios from \"axios\";\n\nconst API_KEY = process.env.HUNTER_API_KEY;\nconst BASE_URL = \"https://api.hunter.io/v2\";\n\nexport const hunterClient = {\n  /**\n   * Busca emails de una empresa\n   * @param {string} domain - Dominio de la empresa (ej: \"empresa.com\")\n   * @param {string} company - Nombre de la empresa (opcional)\n   * @returns {Promise\u003cobject\u003e} - Datos de emails encontrados\n   */\n  async findEmails({ domain, company }) {\n    try {\n      const response = await axios.get(`${BASE_URL}/domain-search`, {\n        params: {\n          domain,\n          company,\n          api_key: API_KEY,\n        },\n      });\n      return response.data.data || { emails: [] };\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error.response?.status === 402) {\n        console.warn(\"Hunter.io: Límite de solicitudes alcanzado\");\n      }\n      console.error(\"Error en Hunter.io:\", error.message);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * Verifica un email\n   */\n  async verifyEmail(email) {\n    try {\n      const response = await axios.get(`${BASE_URL}/email-verifier`, {\n        params: {\n          email,\n          api_key: API_KEY,\n        },\n      });\n      return response.data.data || { result: \"unknown\" };\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error al verificar email en Hunter.io:\", error.message);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  },\n};\n```\n\n---\n### **4.5. Crear `clients/firecrawl.js`**\n```javascript\n// clients/firecrawl.js\nimport axios from \"axios\";\n\nconst API_KEY = process.env.FIRECRAWL_API_KEY;\nconst BASE_URL = \"https://api.firecrawl.dev/v0\";\n\nexport const firecrawlClient = {\n  /**\n   * Scrapea una URL\n   * @param {string} url - URL a scrapear\n   * @param {object} options - Opciones de scraping\n   * @returns {Promise\u003cobject\u003e} - Datos scrapeados\n   */\n  async scrape(url, options = {}) {\n    try {\n      const response = await axios.post(`${BASE_URL}/scrape`, {\n        url,\n        formats: [\"markdown\"],\n        ...options,\n      }, {\n        headers: {\n          \"Authorization\": `Bearer ${API_KEY}`,\n          \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n        },\n      });\n      return response.data.data || {};\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error en Firecrawl:\", error.message);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * Scrapea múltiples URLs\n   */\n  async batchScrape(urls, options = {}) {\n    try {\n      const response = await axios.post(`${BASE_URL}/batch`, {\n        urls: urls.map(url =\u003e ({ url, ...options })),\n      }, {\n        headers: {\n          \"Authorization\": `Bearer ${API_KEY}`,\n          \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n        },\n      });\n      return response.data.data || [];\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error en Firecrawl Batch:\", error.message);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  },\n};\n```\n\n---\n### **4.6. Crear `clients/gmail.js`**\n```javascript\n// clients/gmail.js\nimport { google } from \"googleapis\";\nimport { OAuth2Client } from \"google-auth-library\";\n\nconst oauth2Client = new OAuth2Client(\n  process.env.GMAIL_CLIENT_ID,\n  process.env.GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET,\n  process.env.GMAIL_REDIRECT_URI\n);\n\nexport const gmailClient = {\n  /**\n   * Inicializa el cliente de Gmail con el token\n   */\n  async init(token) {\n    oauth2Client.setCredentials(token);\n    return google.gmail({ version: \"v1\", auth: oauth2Client });\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * Envía un email\n   */\n  async sendEmail({ to, subject, body, from }) {\n    const gmail = await this.init();\n    const raw = this.makeRawEmail({ to, subject, body, from });\n\n    try {\n      const response = await gmail.users.messages.send({\n        userId: \"me\",\n        requestBody: { raw },\n      });\n      return response.data;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error al enviar email:\", error.message);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * Convierte un email a formato raw (base64)\n   */\n  makeRawEmail({ to, subject, body, from }) {\n    const email = [\n      `From: ${from}`,\n      `To: ${to}`,\n      `Subject: ${subject}`,\n      \"MIME-Version: 1.0\",\n      \"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\",\n      \"\",\n      body,\n    ].join(\"\\n\");\n\n    return Buffer.from(email).toString(\"base64\").replace(/\\+/g, \"-\").replace(/\\//g, \"_\");\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * Lista emails no leídos\n   */\n  async listUnreadEmails() {\n    const gmail = await this.init();\n    try {\n      const response = await gmail.users.messages.list({\n        userId: \"me\",\n        q: \"is:unread\",\n      });\n      return response.data.messages || [];\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error al listar emails:\", error.message);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  },\n};\n```\n\n---\n### **4.7. Instalar dependencias necesarias**\n```bash\nnpm install @google/generative-ai @prisma/client axios googleapis google-auth-library\n```\n\n---\n\n---\n\n## **📌 PASO 5: UNIFICAR Y ACTUALIZAR EL SCRIPT `run-agentes.mjs`**\n\n### **5.1. Crear el script definitivo**\n**Archivo:** `scripts/run-agentes.mjs`\n\n```javascript\n// scripts/run-agentes.mjs\nimport { readFile, readdir } from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport { join, dirname } from 'node:path';\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';\nimport yaml from 'js-yaml';\nimport { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';\nimport { geminiClient } from '../clients/gemini.js';\nimport { googlePlacesClient } from '../clients/googlePlaces.js';\nimport { hunterClient } from '../clients/hunter.js';\nimport { firecrawlClient } from '../clients/firecrawl.js';\n\n// Inicializar Prisma\nconst prisma = new PrismaClient();\nconst __dirname = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));\n\n// Cargar el roster YAML\nconst rosterPath = join(__dirname, '..', 'config', 'roster.yaml');\nconst roster = yaml.load(await readFile(rosterPath, 'utf8'));\n\n// Mapeo de acciones por agente\nconst agentActions = {\n  'prospeccion': prospeccionAction,\n  'enriquecimiento': enriquecimientoAction,\n  'analista-web': analistaWebAction,\n  'copywriter': copywriterAction,\n  // Añadir más acciones según sea necesario\n};\n\n/**\n * Carga la ficha de un agente desde su carpeta\n */\nasync function loadAgentSlug(slug) {\n  const [department, name] = slug.split('/');\n  const agentDir = join(__dirname, '..', 'agentes', department, name);\n\n  try {\n    const files = await readdir(agentDir);\n    const agent = {};\n\n    for (const file of files) {\n      if (file.endsWith('.md')) {\n        const content = await readFile(join(agentDir, file), 'utf8');\n        agent[file.replace('.md', '')] = content;\n      }\n    }\n\n    return {\n      slug,\n      department,\n      name,\n      ...agent,\n    };\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(`❌ No se encontró el agente ${slug}:`, error.message);\n    return null;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Ejecuta una acción de un agente\n */\nasync function executeAgent(agent, task) {\n  const action = agentActions[agent.department] || defaultAction;\n  const context = {\n    prisma,\n    gemini: geminiClient,\n    googlePlaces: googlePlacesClient,\n    hunter: hunterClient,\n    firecrawl: firecrawlClient,\n    log: (message) =\u003e console.log(`[${agent.slug}] ${message}`),\n  };\n\n  try {\n    const result = await action(agent, task.input, context);\n    return { success: true, data: result };\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(`❌ Error en ${agent.slug}:`, error.message);\n    return { success: false, error: error.message };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Acción por defecto (si no hay una específica)\n */\nasync function defaultAction(agent, input, context) {\n  const prompt = `\n    Eres el agente \"${agent.name}\" del departamento \"${agent.department}\".\n    Tu identidad: ${agent.identidad}\n    Tu proceso: ${agent.proceso}\n    Tu skill: ${agent.skill}\n\n    Tarea: ${JSON.stringify(input, null, 2)}\n\n    Ejecuta la tarea y devuelve el resultado en JSON.\n  `;\n\n  const response = await context.gemini.generateContent(prompt);\n  return JSON.parse(response || '{}');\n}\n\n/**\n * Acción para el agente de Prospección\n */\nasync function prospeccionAction(agent, input, context) {\n  const { industry, location, limit = 10 } = input;\n\n  context.log(`Buscando ${limit} empresas de ${industry} en ${location}...`);\n\n  // 1. Buscar en Google Places\n  const companies = await context.googlePlaces.textSearch({\n    query: `${industry} in ${location}`,\n    radius: 50000,\n  });\n\n  // 2. Filtrar empresas con sitio web o teléfono\n  const filtered = companies\n    .filter(c =\u003e c.website || c.formatted_phone_number)\n    .slice(0, limit);\n\n  if (filtered.length === 0) {\n    throw new Error(`No se encontraron empresas de ${industry} en ${location}`);\n  }\n\n  // 3. Guardar en Neon\n  const createdCompanies = await Promise.all(\n    filtered.map(async (c) =\u003e {\n      return prisma.company.upsert({\n        where: { placeId: c.place_id },\n        create: {\n          name: c.name,\n          address: c.vicinity,\n          website: c.website,\n          phone: c.formatted_phone_number,\n          placeId: c.place_id,\n          latitude: c.geometry?.location?.lat,\n          longitude: c.geometry?.location?.lng,\n          status: \"raw\",\n          industry,\n          location,\n        },\n        update: {\n          name: c.name,\n          address: c.vicinity,\n          website: c.website,\n          phone: c.formatted_phone_number,\n          latitude: c.geometry?.location?.lat,\n          longitude: c.geometry?.location?.lng,\n        },\n      });\n    })\n  );\n\n  return {\n    companies: createdCompanies.map(c =\u003e ({\n      id: c.id,\n      name: c.name,\n      website: c.website,\n      phone: c.phone,\n    })),\n    count: createdCompanies.length,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Acción para el agente de Enriquecimiento\n */\nasync function enriquecimientoAction(agent, input, context) {\n  const { leadId, companyName, website } = input;\n\n  context.log(`Enriqueciendo lead ${leadId} (${companyName})...`);\n\n  // 1. Buscar emails con Hunter.io\n  let emails = [];\n  try {\n    const domain = new URL(website).hostname;\n    const hunterResult = await context.hunter.findEmails({ domain, company: companyName });\n    emails = hunterResult.emails?.map(e =\u003e e.value) || [];\n  } catch (error) {\n    context.log(`Hunter falló para ${website}: ${error.message}`);\n  }\n\n  // 2. Scrapear sitio web con Firecrawl\n  let scrapedData = null;\n  try {\n    scrapedData = await context.firecrawl.scrape(website, {\n      formats: [\"markdown\"],\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    context.log(`Firecrawl falló para ${website}: ${error.message}`);\n  }\n\n  // 3. Buscar teléfonos en el sitio (regex)\n  const phones = [];\n  if (scrapedData?.markdown) {\n    const phoneRegex = /(\\+?\\d{1,3}[-.\\s]?)?\\(?\\d{3}\\)?[-.\\s]?\\d{3}[-.\\s]?\\d{4}/g;\n    const foundPhones = scrapedData.markdown.match(phoneRegex) || [];\n    phones.push(...foundPhones.filter(p =\u003e !phones.includes(p)));\n  }\n\n  // 4. Buscar redes sociales\n  const socialMedia = {};\n  if (scrapedData?.markdown) {\n    const socialLinks = scrapedData.markdown.match(/https?:\\/\\/(www\\.)?(linkedin|twitter|facebook|instagram)\\.com\\/[a-zA-Z0-9(\\-_@.)]+\\/?/g) || [];\n    socialLinks.forEach(link =\u003e {\n      if (link.includes(\"linkedin\")) socialMedia.linkedin = link;\n      if (link.includes(\"twitter\")) socialMedia.twitter = link;\n      if (link.includes(\"facebook\")) socialMedia.facebook = link;\n      if (link.includes(\"instagram\")) socialMedia.instagram = link;\n    });\n  }\n\n  // 5. Calcular confidence score (0-100)\n  let confidenceScore = 50;\n  if (emails.length \u003e= 1) confidenceScore += 20;\n  if (phones.length \u003e= 1) confidenceScore += 15;\n  if (socialMedia.linkedin) confidenceScore += 10;\n  if (scrapedData) confidenceScore += 15;\n\n  // 6. Actualizar lead en Neon\n  await prisma.company.update({\n    where: { id: leadId },\n    data: {\n      emails,\n      phones,\n      socialMedia,\n      scrapedData: scrapedData?.markdown,\n      confidenceScore,\n      status: \"enriched\",\n      updatedAt: new Date(),\n    },\n  });\n\n  return {\n    emails,\n    phones,\n    socialMedia,\n    confidenceScore,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Acción para el agente Analista Web\n */\nasync function analistaWebAction(agent, input, context) {\n  const { leadId, website } = input;\n\n  context.log(`Analizando sitio web de ${website}...`);\n\n  // 1. Scrapear con Firecrawl\n  const scrapedData = await context.firecrawl.scrape(website);\n\n  // 2. Analizar con Lighthouse (opcional, requiere Node.js 18+)\n  // const lighthouse = await context.lighthouse.analyze(website);\n\n  // 3. Detectar tecnologías con Wappalyzer (simplificado)\n  const technologies = [];\n  if (scrapedData.markdown) {\n    if (scrapedData.markdown.includes(\"WordPress\")) technologies.push(\"WordPress\");\n    if (scrapedData.markdown.includes(\"Shopify\")) technologies.push(\"Shopify\");\n    if (scrapedData.markdown.includes(\"React\")) technologies.push(\"React\");\n  }\n\n  // 4. Identificar oportunidades\n  const oportunidades = [];\n  if (!scrapedData.markdown.includes(\"chatbot\")) {\n    oportunidades.push(\"No tiene chatbot (opportunidad para automatización)\");\n  }\n  if (scrapedData.markdown.includes(\"contacto@\") \u0026\u0026 !scrapedData.markdown.includes(\"WhatsApp\")) {\n    oportunidades.push(\"Tiene email pero no WhatsApp (opportunidad para multicanal)\");\n  }\n\n  // 5. Guardar diagnóstico en Neon\n  await prisma.company.update({\n    where: { id: leadId },\n    data: {\n      analysis: {\n        technologies,\n        oportunidades,\n        contentLength: scrapedData.markdown?.length || 0,\n      },\n      status: \"analyzed\",\n      updatedAt: new Date(),\n    },\n  });\n\n  return {\n    technologies,\n    oportunidades,\n    contentLength: scrapedData.markdown?.length || 0,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Acción para el agente Copywriter\n */\nasync function copywriterAction(agent, input, context) {\n  const { leadId, companyName, industry, painPoints = [], valueProposition } = input;\n\n  context.log(`Generando secuencia de outreach para ${companyName}...`);\n\n  // 1. Generar prompt para Gemini\n  const prompt = `\n    Eres un experto en ventas B2B para la industria \"${industry}\".\n    La empresa \"${companyName}\" tiene los siguientes puntos de dolor: ${painPoints.join(', ')}.\n    Nuestra propuesta de valor es: \"${valueProposition}\".\n\n    Genera:\n    1. Una secuencia de 3 emails (asunto + cuerpo) para contactar a esta empresa.\n       - Email 1: Presentación inicial (máx 150 palabras).\n       - Email 2: Seguimiento (3 días después, máx 100 palabras).\n       - Email 3: Último intento (7 días después, máx 100 palabras).\n    2. Un mensaje para LinkedIn (máx 200 caracteres).\n    3. Un mensaje para WhatsApp (máx 160 caracteres).\n    4. Un guion de llamada (puntos clave para una llamada de 2 minutos).\n\n    Formato de salida (JSON):\n    {\n      \"emailSequence\": [\n        { \"subject\": \"Asunto 1\", \"body\": \"Cuerpo 1\", \"delayDays\": 0 },\n        { \"subject\": \"Asunto 2\", \"body\": \"Cuerpo 2\", \"delayDays\": 3 },\n        { \"subject\": \"Asunto 3\", \"body\": \"Cuerpo 3\", \"delayDays\": 7 }\n      ],\n      \"linkedinMessage\": \"Mensaje para LinkedIn\",\n      \"whatsappMessage\": \"Mensaje para WhatsApp\",\n      \"callScript\": \"Guion de llamada\"\n    }\n  `;\n\n  // 2. Generar contenido con Gemini\n  const response = await context.gemini.generateContent(prompt);\n\n  try {\n    const result = JSON.parse(response);\n    return result;\n  } catch (error) {\n    // Si no es JSON válido, devolver el texto crudo\n    return {\n      emailSequence: [\n        { subject: \"Presentación\", body: response, delayDays: 0 },\n        { subject: \"Seguimiento\", body: response, delayDays: 3 },\n        { subject: \"Último intento\", body: response, delayDays: 7 },\n      ],\n      linkedinMessage: response.substring(0, 200),\n      whatsappMessage: response.substring(0, 160),\n      callScript: response.substring(0, 500),\n    };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Carga todos los agentes desde el roster\n */\nasync function loadAllAgents() {\n  const agents = {};\n  for (const [department, names] of Object.entries(roster)) {\n    for (const name of names) {\n      const slug = `${department}/${name}`;\n      const agent = await loadAgentSlug(slug);\n      if (agent) {\n        agents[slug] = agent;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return agents;\n}\n\n/**\n * Ejecuta una tarea\n */\nasync function runTask(task) {\n  const agent = await loadAgentSlug(task.agentSlug);\n  if (!agent) {\n    throw new Error(`Agente ${task.agentSlug} no encontrado`);\n  }\n\n  const execution = await prisma.agentExecution.create({\n    data: {\n      agentSlug: task.agentSlug,\n      input: task.input,\n      status: \"in_progress\",\n    },\n  });\n\n  try {\n    const result = await executeAgent(agent, task);\n    await prisma.agentExecution.update({\n      where: { id: execution.id },\n      data: {\n        output: result.data,\n        status: \"completed\",\n        tokensUsed: result.tokensUsed || 0,\n        updatedAt: new Date(),\n      },\n    });\n    return { success: true, data: result.data, executionId: execution.id };\n  } catch (error) {\n    await prisma.agentExecution.update({\n      where: { id: execution.id },\n      data: {\n        error: error.message,\n        status: \"failed\",\n        updatedAt: new Date(),\n      },\n    });\n    throw error;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Función principal\n */\nasync function main() {\n  console.log(\"🚀 Iniciando sistema de agentes de Clientum...\");\n\n  // Cargar todos los agentes\n  const agents = await loadAllAgents();\n  console.log(`✅ ${Object.keys(agents).length} agentes cargados`);\n\n  // Ejemplo: Ejecutar tarea de prospección\n  const task = {\n    agentSlug: \"ventas/prospector\", // Ajustar según el roster\n    input: {\n      industry: \"distribuidoras de generadores\",\n      location: \"Córdoba, Argentina\",\n      limit: 10,\n    },\n  };\n\n  try {\n    const result = await runTask(task);\n    console.log(\"✅ Tarea completada:\", result.data);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(\"❌ Error:\", error.message);\n  } finally {\n    await prisma.$disconnect();\n  }\n}\n\n// Ejecutar si se llamó directamente\nif (import.meta.url === `file://${process.argv[1]}`) {\n  main().catch(console.error);\n}\n\n// Exportar funciones para uso externo\nexport { runTask, loadAllAgents, loadAgentSlug };\n```\n\n---\n### Configurar Prisma**\n1. **Instalar Prisma** (si no está instalado):\n   ```bash\n   npm install prisma @prisma/client\n   ```\n\n2. **Inicializar Prisma**:\n   ```bash\n   npx prisma init\n   ```\n   *(Esto creará `prisma/schema.prisma` y `.env`)*\n\n3. **Editar `prisma/schema.prisma`**:\n   ```prisma\n   // prisma/schema.prisma\n   generator client {\n     provider = \"prisma-client-js\"\n   }\n\n   datasource db {\n     provider = \"postgresql\"\n     url      = env(\"DATABASE_URL\")\n   }\n\n   // Modelos de la base de datos\n   model Agent {\n     id          String   @id @default(cuid())\n     slug        String   @unique  // Ej: \"customer-success-asesor\"\n     department  String\n     name        String\n     identity    Json     // Contenido de identidad.md\n     memory      Json     // Contenido de memoria.md\n     process     Json     // Contenido de proceso.md\n     skill       Json     // Contenido de skill.md\n     createdAt   DateTime @default(now())\n     updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt\n   }\n\n   model AgentExecution {\n     id          String   @id @default(cuid())\n     agentSlug   String\n     agent       Agent    @relation(fields: [agentSlug], references: [slug])\n     input       Json\n     output      Json?\n     status      String   // \"pending\", \"in_progress\", \"completed\", \"failed\"\n     retries     Int      @default(0)\n     error       String?\n     tokensUsed  Int      @default(0)\n     costEstimate Float   @default(0)\n     createdAt   DateTime @default(now())\n     updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt\n   }\n\n   model Company {\n     id          String   @id @default(cuid())\n     name        String\n     address     String?\n     website     String?\n     phone       String?\n     emails      String[] // Array de emails\n     industry    String?\n     location    String?\n     placeId     String?  // Google Places ID\n     latitude    Float?\n     longitude   Float?\n     status      String   @default(\"raw\") // \"raw\", \"enriched\", \"analyzed\", \"contacted\"\n     confidenceScore Int  @default(0) // 0-100\n     createdAt   DateTime @default(now())\n     updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt\n   }\n\n   model Lead {\n     id          String   @id @default(cuid())\n     companyId   String\n     company     Company  @relation(fields: [companyId], references: [id])\n     name        String?\n     role        String?\n     email       String?\n     phone       String?\n     linkedin    String?\n     status      String   @default(\"new\") // \"new\", \"contacted\", \"meeting\", \"closed\", \"lost\"\n     score       Int      @default(0) // 0-100\n     createdAt   DateTime @default(now())\n     updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt\n   }\n\n   model Task {\n     id          String   @id @default(cuid())\n     agentSlug   String\n     agent       Agent    @relation(fields: [agentSlug], references: [slug])\n     input       Json\n     output      Json?\n     status      String   @default(\"pending\") // \"pending\", \"in_progress\", \"completed\", \"failed\"\n     retries     Int      @default(0)\n     error       String?\n     createdAt   DateTime @default(now())\n     updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt\n   }\n   ```\n\n4. **Aplicar el esquema a Neon**:\n   ```bash\n   npx prisma db push\n   ```\n\n5. **Generar el cliente de Prisma**:\n   ```bash\n   npx prisma generate\n   ```\n\n---\n\n---\n\n## **📌 PASO 4: CREAR LOS CLIENTES DE APIs**\n\n### **4.1. Crear la carpeta `clients/`**\n```bash\nmkdir -p clients\n```\n\n---\n\n### **4.2. Crear `clients/gemini.js`**\n```javascript\n// clients/gemini.js\nimport { GoogleGenerativeAI } from \"@google/generative-ai\";\n\nconst genAI = new GoogleGenerativeAI(process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY);\n\nexport const geminiClient = {\n  /**\n   * Genera contenido usando Gemini\n   * @param {string} prompt - El prompt para el modelo\n   * @param {object} options - Opciones adicionales (model, temperature, etc.)\n   * @returns {Promise\u003cstring\u003e} - Respuesta de texto\n   */\n  async generateContent(prompt, options = {}) {\n    const model = genAI.getGenerativeModel({\n      model: options.model || \"gemini-1.5-flash\",\n      generationConfig: {\n        temperature: options.temperature || 0.7,\n        maxOutputTokens: options.maxTokens || 2000,\n      },\n    });\n\n    const result = await model.generateContent(prompt);\n    return result.response.text();\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * Genera contenido con streaming\n   */\n  async generateContentStream(prompt, options = {}) {\n    const model = genAI.getGenerativeModel({\n      model: options.model || \"gemini-1.5-flash\",\n      generationConfig: {\n        temperature: options.temperature || 0.7,\n      },\n    });\n\n    const result = await model.generateContentStream(prompt);\n    return result.stream;\n  },\n};\n```\n\n---\n\n### **4.3. Crear `clients/googlePlaces.js`**\n```javascript\n// clients/googlePlaces.js\nimport axios from \"axios\";\n\nconst API_KEY = process.env.GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY;\nconst BASE_URL = \"https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/place\";\n\nexport const googlePlacesClient = {\n  /**\n   * Busca empresas por texto\n   * @param {object} params - Parámetros de búsqueda\n   * @param {string} params.query - Consulta de búsqueda (ej: \"distribuidoras de generadores\")\n   * @param {string} params.location - Ubicación (lat,lng)\n   * @param {number} params.radius - Radio en metros (máx 50000)\n   * @returns {Promise\u003cArray\u003e} - Lista de empresas\n   */\n  async textSearch({ query, location, radius = 50000 }) {\n    try {\n      const response = await axios.get(`${BASE_URL}/textsearch/json`, {\n        params: {\n          query,\n          location,\n          radius,\n          type: \"establishment\",\n          key: API_KEY,\n        },\n      });\n      return response.data.results || [];\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error en Google Places Text Search:\", error.message);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * Obtiene detalles de un lugar\n   */\n  async getPlaceDetails(placeId) {\n    try {\n      const response = await axios.get(`${BASE_URL}/details/json`, {\n        params: {\n          place_id: placeId,\n          key: API_KEY,\n        },\n      });\n      return response.data.result || null;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error en Google Places Details:\", error.message);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  },\n};\n```\n\n---\n\n### **4.4. Crear `clients/hunter.js`**\n```javascript\n// clients/hunter.js\nimport axios from \"axios\";\n\nconst API_KEY = process.env.HUNTER_API_KEY;\nconst BASE_URL = \"https://api.hunter.io/v2\";\n\nexport const hunterClient = {\n  /**\n   * Busca emails de una empresa\n   * @param {string} domain - Dominio de la empresa (ej: \"empresa.com\")\n   * @param {string} company - Nombre de la empresa (opcional)\n   * @returns {Promise\u003cobject\u003e} - Datos de emails encontrados\n   */\n  async findEmails({ domain, company }) {\n    try {\n      const response = await axios.get(`${BASE_URL}/domain-search`, {\n        params: {\n          domain,\n          company,\n          api_key: API_KEY,\n        },\n      });\n      return response.data.data || { emails: [] };\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error.response?.status === 402) {\n        console.warn(\"Hunter.io: Límite de solicitudes alcanzado\");\n      }\n      console.error(\"Error en Hunter.io:\", error.message);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * Verifica un email\n   */\n  async verifyEmail(email) {\n    try {\n      const response = await axios.get(`${BASE_URL}/email-verifier`, {\n        params: {\n          email,\n          api_key: API_KEY,\n        },\n      });\n      return response.data.data || { result: \"unknown\" };\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error al verificar email en Hunter.io:\", error.message);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  },\n};\n```\n\n---\n### **4.5. Crear `clients/firecrawl.js`**\n```javascript\n// clients/firecrawl.js\nimport axios from \"axios\";\n\nconst API_KEY = process.env.FIRECRAWL_API_KEY;\nconst BASE_URL = \"https://api.firecrawl.dev/v0\";\n\nexport const firecrawlClient = {\n  /**\n   * Scrapea una URL\n   * @param {string} url - URL a scrapear\n   * @param {object} options - Opciones de scraping\n   * @returns {Promise\u003cobject\u003e} - Datos scrapeados\n   */\n  async scrape(url, options = {}) {\n    try {\n      const response = await axios.post(`${BASE_URL}/scrape`, {\n        url,\n        formats: [\"markdown\"],\n        ...options,\n      }, {\n        headers: {\n          \"Authorization\": `Bearer ${API_KEY}`,\n          \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n        },\n      });\n      return response.data.data || {};\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error en Firecrawl:\", error.message);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * Scrapea múltiples URLs\n   */\n  async batchScrape(urls, options = {}) {\n    try {\n      const response = await axios.post(`${BASE_URL}/batch`, {\n        urls: urls.map(url =\u003e ({ url, ...options })),\n      }, {\n        headers: {\n          \"Authorization\": `Bearer ${API_KEY}`,\n          \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n        },\n      });\n      return response.data.data || [];\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error en Firecrawl Batch:\", error.message);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  },\n};\n```\n\n---\n### **4.6. Crear `clients/gmail.js`**\n```javascript\n// clients/gmail.js\nimport { google } from \"googleapis\";\nimport { OAuth2Client } from \"google-auth-library\";\n\nconst oauth2Client = new OAuth2Client(\n  process.env.GMAIL_CLIENT_ID,\n  process.env.GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET,\n  process.env.GMAIL_REDIRECT_URI\n);\n\nexport const gmailClient = {\n  /**\n   * Inicializa el cliente de Gmail con el token\n   */\n  async init(token) {\n    oauth2Client.setCredentials(token);\n    return google.gmail({ version: \"v1\", auth: oauth2Client });\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * Envía un email\n   */\n  async sendEmail({ to, subject, body, from }) {\n    const gmail = await this.init();\n    const raw = this.makeRawEmail({ to, subject, body, from });\n\n    try {\n      const response = await gmail.users.messages.send({\n        userId: \"me\",\n        requestBody: { raw },\n      });\n      return response.data;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error al enviar email:\", error.message);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * Convierte un email a formato raw (base64)\n   */\n  makeRawEmail({ to, subject, body, from }) {\n    const email = [\n      `From: ${from}`,\n      `To: ${to}`,\n      `Subject: ${subject}`,\n      \"MIME-Version: 1.0\",\n      \"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\",\n      \"\",\n      body,\n    ].join(\"\\n\");\n\n    return Buffer.from(email).toString(\"base64\").replace(/\\+/g, \"-\").replace(/\\//g, \"_\");\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * Lista emails no leídos\n   */\n  async listUnreadEmails() {\n    const gmail = await this.init();\n    try {\n      const response = await gmail.users.messages.list({\n        userId: \"me\",\n        q: \"is:unread\",\n      });\n      return response.data.messages || [];\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error al listar emails:\", error.message);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  },\n};\n```\n\n---\n### **4.7. Instalar dependencias necesarias**\n```bash\nnpm install @google/generative-ai @prisma/client axios googleapis google-auth-library\n```\n\n---\n\n---\n\n## **📌 PASO 5: UNIFICAR Y ACTUALIZAR EL SCRIPT `run-agentes.mjs`**\n\n### **5.1. Crear el script definitivo**\n**Archivo:** `scripts/run-agentes.mjs`\n\n```javascript\n// scripts/run-agentes.mjs\nimport { readFile, readdir } from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport { join, dirname } from 'node:path';\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';\nimport yaml from 'js-yaml';\nimport { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';\nimport { geminiClient } from '../clients/gemini.js';\nimport { googlePlacesClient } from '../clients/googlePlaces.js';\nimport { hunterClient } from '../clients/hunter.js';\nimport { firecrawlClient } from '../clients/firecrawl.js';\n\n// Inicializar Prisma\nconst prisma = new PrismaClient();\nconst __dirname = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));\n\n// Cargar el roster YAML\nconst rosterPath = join(__dirname, '..', 'config', 'roster.yaml');\nconst roster = yaml.load(await readFile(rosterPath, 'utf8'));\n\n// Mapeo de acciones por agente\nconst agentActions = {\n  'prospeccion': prospeccionAction,\n  'enriquecimiento': enriquecimientoAction,\n  'analista-web': analistaWebAction,\n  'copywriter': copywriterAction,\n  // Añadir más acciones según sea necesario\n};\n\n/**\n * Carga la ficha de un agente desde su carpeta\n */\nasync function loadAgentSlug(slug) {\n  const [department, name] = slug.split('/');\n  const agentDir = join(__dirname, '..', 'agentes', department, name);\n\n  try {\n    const files = await readdir(agentDir);\n    const agent = {};\n\n    for (const file of files) {\n      if (file.endsWith('.md')) {\n        const content = await readFile(join(agentDir, file), 'utf8');\n        agent[file.replace('.md', '')] = content;\n      }\n    }\n\n    return {\n      slug,\n      department,\n      name,\n      ...agent,\n    };\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(`❌ No se encontró el agente ${slug}:`, error.message);\n    return null;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Ejecuta una acción de un agente\n */\nasync function executeAgent(agent, task) {\n  const action = agentActions[agent.department] || defaultAction;\n  const context = {\n    prisma,\n    gemini: geminiClient,\n    googlePlaces: googlePlacesClient,\n    hunter: hunterClient,\n    firecrawl: firecrawlClient,\n    log: (message) =\u003e console.log(`[${agent.slug}] ${message}`),\n  };\n\n  try {\n    const result = await action(agent, task.input, context);\n    return { success: true, data: result };\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(`❌ Error en ${agent.slug}:`, error.message);\n    return { success: false, error: error.message };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Acción por defecto (si no hay una específica)\n */\nasync function defaultAction(agent, input, context) {\n  const prompt = `\n    Eres el agente \"${agent.name}\" del departamento \"${agent.department}\".\n    Tu identidad: ${agent.identidad}\n    Tu proceso: ${agent.proceso}\n    Tu skill: ${agent.skill}\n\n    Tarea: ${JSON.stringify(input, null, 2)}\n\n    Ejecuta la tarea y devuelve el resultado en JSON.\n  `;\n\n  const response = await context.gemini.generateContent(prompt);\n  return JSON.parse(response || '{}');\n}\n\n/**\n * Acción para el agente de Prospección\n */\nasync function prospeccionAction(agent, input, context) {\n  const { industry, location, limit = 10 } = input;\n\n  context.log(`Buscando ${limit} empresas de ${industry} en ${location}...`);\n\n  // 1. Buscar en Google Places\n  const companies = await context.googlePlaces.textSearch({\n    query: `${industry} in ${location}`,\n    radius: 50000,\n  });\n\n  // 2. Filtrar empresas con sitio web o teléfono\n  const filtered = companies\n    .filter(c =\u003e c.website || c.formatted_phone_number)\n    .slice(0, limit);\n\n  if (filtered.length === 0) {\n    throw new Error(`No se encontraron empresas de ${industry} en ${location}`);\n  }\n\n  // 3. Guardar en Neon\n  const createdCompanies = await Promise.all(\n    filtered.map(async (c) =\u003e {\n      return prisma.company.upsert({\n        where: { placeId: c.place_id },\n        create: {\n          name: c.name,\n          address: c.vicinity,\n          website: c.website,\n          phone: c.formatted_phone_number,\n          placeId: c.place_id,\n          latitude: c.geometry?.location?.lat,\n          longitude: c.geometry?.location?.lng,\n          status: \"raw\",\n          industry,\n          location,\n        },\n        update: {\n          name: c.name,\n          address: c.vicinity,\n          website: c.website,\n          phone: c.formatted_phone_number,\n          latitude: c.geometry?.location?.lat,\n          longitude: c.geometry?.location?.lng,\n        },\n      });\n    })\n  );\n\n  return {\n    companies: createdCompanies.map(c =\u003e ({\n      id: c.id,\n      name: c.name,\n      website: c.website,\n      phone: c.phone,\n    })),\n    count: createdCompanies.length,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Acción para el agente de Enriquecimiento\n */\nasync function enriquecimientoAction(agent, input, context) {\n  const { leadId, companyName, website } = input;\n\n  context.log(`Enriqueciendo lead ${leadId} (${companyName})...`);\n\n  // 1. Buscar emails con Hunter.io\n  let emails = [];\n  try {\n    const domain = new URL(website).hostname;\n    const hunterResult = await context.hunter.findEmails({ domain, company: companyName });\n    emails = hunterResult.emails?.map(e =\u003e e.value) || [];\n  } catch (error) {\n    context.log(`Hunter falló para ${website}: ${error.message}`);\n  }\n\n  // 2. Scrapear sitio web con Firecrawl\n  let scrapedData = null;\n  try {\n    scrapedData = await context.firecrawl.scrape(website, {\n      formats: [\"markdown\"],\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    context.log(`Firecrawl falló para ${website}: ${error.message}`);\n  }\n\n  // 3. Buscar teléfonos en el sitio (regex)\n  const phones = [];\n  if (scrapedData?.markdown) {\n    const phoneRegex = /(\\+?\\d{1,3}[-.\\s]?)?\\(?\\d{3}\\)?[-.\\s]?\\d{3}[-.\\s]?\\d{4}/g;\n    const foundPhones = scrapedData.markdown.match(phoneRegex) || [];\n    phones.push(...foundPhones.filter(p =\u003e !phones.includes(p)));\n  }\n\n  // 4. Buscar redes sociales\n  const socialMedia = {};\n  if (scrapedData?.markdown) {\n    const socialLinks = scrapedData.markdown.match(/https?:\\/\\/(www\\.)?(linkedin|twitter|facebook|instagram)\\.com\\/[a-zA-Z0-9(\\-_@.)]+\\/?/g) || [];\n    socialLinks.forEach(link =\u003e {\n      if (link.includes(\"linkedin\")) socialMedia.linkedin = link;\n      if (link.includes(\"twitter\")) socialMedia.twitter = link;\n      if (link.includes(\"facebook\")) socialMedia.facebook = link;\n      if (link.includes(\"instagram\")) socialMedia.instagram = link;\n    });\n  }\n\n  // 5. Calcular confidence score (0-100)\n  let confidenceScore = 50;\n  if (emails.length \u003e= 1) confidenceScore += 20;\n  if (phones.length \u003e= 1) confidenceScore += 15;\n  if (socialMedia.linkedin) confidenceScore += 10;\n  if (scrapedData) confidenceScore += 15;\n\n  // 6. Actualizar lead en Neon\n  await prisma.company.update({\n    where: { id: leadId },\n    data: {\n      emails,\n      phones,\n      socialMedia,\n      scrapedData: scrapedData?.markdown,\n      confidenceScore,\n      status: \"enriched\",\n      updatedAt: new Date(),\n    },\n  });\n\n  return {\n    emails,\n    phones,\n    socialMedia,\n    confidenceScore,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Acción para el agente Analista Web\n */\nasync function analistaWebAction(agent, input, context) {\n  const { leadId, website } = input;\n\n  context.log(`Analizando sitio web de ${website}...`);\n\n  // 1. Scrapear con Firecrawl\n  const scrapedData = await context.firecrawl.scrape(website);\n\n  // 2. Analizar con Lighthouse (opcional, requiere Node.js 18+)\n  // const lighthouse = await context.lighthouse.analyze(website);\n\n  // 3. Detectar tecnologías con Wappalyzer (simplificado)\n  const technologies = [];\n  if (scrapedData.markdown) {\n    if (scrapedData.markdown.includes(\"WordPress\")) technologies.push(\"WordPress\");\n    if (scrapedData.markdown.includes(\"Shopify\")) technologies.push(\"Shopify\");\n    if (scrapedData.markdown.includes(\"React\")) technologies.push(\"React\");\n  }\n\n  // 4. Identificar oportunidades\n  const oportunidades = [];\n  if (!scrapedData.markdown.includes(\"chatbot\")) {\n    oportunidades.push(\"No tiene chatbot (opportunidad para automatización)\");\n  }\n  if (scrapedData.markdown.includes(\"contacto@\") \u0026\u0026 !scrapedData.markdown.includes(\"WhatsApp\")) {\n    oportunidades.push(\"Tiene email pero no WhatsApp (opportunidad para multicanal)\");\n  }\n\n  // 5. Guardar diagnóstico en Neon\n  await prisma.company.update({\n    where: { id: leadId },\n    data: {\n      analysis: {\n        technologies,\n        oportunidades,\n        contentLength: scrapedData.markdown?.length || 0,\n      },\n      status: \"analyzed\",\n      updatedAt: new Date(),\n    },\n  });\n\n  return {\n    technologies,\n    oportunidades,\n    contentLength: scrapedData.markdown?.length || 0,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Acción para el agente Copywriter\n */\nasync function copywriterAction(agent, input, context) {\n  const { leadId, companyName, industry, painPoints = [], valueProposition } = input;\n\n  context.log(`Generando secuencia de outreach para ${companyName}...`);\n\n  // 1. Generar prompt para Gemini\n  const prompt = `\n    Eres un experto en ventas B2B para la industria \"${industry}\".\n    La empresa \"${companyName}\" tiene los siguientes puntos de dolor: ${painPoints.join(', ')}.\n    Nuestra propuesta de valor es: \"${valueProposition}\".\n\n    Genera:\n    1. Una secuencia de 3 emails (asunto + cuerpo) para contactar a esta empresa.\n       - Email 1: Presentación inicial (máx 150 palabras).\n       - Email 2: Seguimiento (3 días después, máx 100 palabras).\n       - Email 3: Último intento (7 días después, máx 100 palabras).\n    2. Un mensaje para LinkedIn (máx 200 caracteres).\n    3. Un mensaje para WhatsApp (máx 160 caracteres).\n    4. Un guion de llamada (puntos clave para una llamada de 2 minutos).\n\n    Formato de salida (JSON):\n    {\n      \"emailSequence\": [\n        { \"subject\": \"Asunto 1\", \"body\": \"Cuerpo 1\", \"delayDays\": 0 },\n        { \"subject\": \"Asunto 2\", \"body\": \"Cuerpo 2\", \"delayDays\": 3 },\n        { \"subject\": \"Asunto 3\", \"body\": \"Cuerpo 3\", \"delayDays\": 7 }\n      ],\n      \"linkedinMessage\": \"Mensaje para LinkedIn\",\n      \"whatsappMessage\": \"Mensaje para WhatsApp\",\n      \"callScript\": \"Guion de llamada\"\n    }\n  `;\n\n  // 2. Generar contenido con Gemini\n  const response = await context.gemini.generateContent(prompt);\n\n  try {\n    const result = JSON.parse(response);\n    return result;\n  } catch (error) {\n    // Si no es JSON válido, devolver el texto crudo\n    return {\n      emailSequence: [\n        { subject: \"Presentación\", body: response, delayDays: 0 },\n        { subject: \"Seguimiento\", body: response, delayDays: 3 },\n        { subject: \"Último intento\", body: response, delayDays: 7 },\n      ],\n      linkedinMessage: response.substring(0, 200),\n      whatsappMessage: response.substring(0, 160),\n      callScript: response.substring(0, 500),\n    };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Carga todos los agentes desde el roster\n */\nasync function loadAllAgents() {\n  const agents = {};\n  for (const [department, names] of Object.entries(roster)) {\n    for (const name of names) {\n      const slug = `${department}/${name}`;\n      const agent = await loadAgentSlug(slug);\n      if (agent) {\n        agents[slug] = agent;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return agents;\n}\n\n/**\n * Ejecuta una tarea\n */\nasync function runTask(task) {\n  const agent = await loadAgentSlug(task.agentSlug);\n  if (!agent) {\n    throw new Error(`Agente ${task.agentSlug} no encontrado`);\n  }\n\n  const execution = await prisma.agentExecution.create({\n    data: {\n      agentSlug: task.agentSlug,\n      input: task.input,\n      status: \"in_progress\",\n    },\n  });\n\n  try {\n    const result = await executeAgent(agent, task);\n    await prisma.agentExecution.update({\n      where: { id: execution.id },\n      data: {\n        output: result.data,\n        status: \"completed\",\n        tokensUsed: result.tokensUsed || 0,\n        updatedAt: new Date(),\n      },\n    });\n    return { success: true, data: result.data, executionId: execution.id };\n  } catch (error) {\n    await prisma.agentExecution.update({\n      where: { id: execution.id },\n      data: {\n        error: error.message,\n        status: \"failed\",\n        updatedAt: new Date(),\n      },\n    });\n    throw error;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Función principal\n */\nasync function main() {\n  console.log(\"🚀 Iniciando sistema de agentes de Clientum...\");\n\n  // Cargar todos los agentes\n  const agents = await loadAllAgents();\n  console.log(`✅ ${Object.keys(agents).length} agentes cargados`);\n\n  // Ejemplo: Ejecutar tarea de prospección\n  const task = {\n    agentSlug: \"ventas/prospector\", // Ajustar según el roster\n    input: {\n      industry: \"distribuidoras de generadores\",\n      location: \"Córdoba, Argentina\",\n      limit: 10,\n    },\n  };\n\n  try {\n    const result = await runTask(task);\n    console.log(\"✅ Tarea completada:\", result.data);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(\"❌ Error:\", error.message);\n  } finally {\n    await prisma.$disconnect();\n  }\n}\n\n// Ejecutar si se llamó directamente\nif (import.meta.url === `file://${process.argv[1]}`) {\n  main().catch(console.error);\n}\n\n// Exportar funciones para uso externo\nexport { runTask, loadAllAgents, loadAgentSlug };\n```\n\n---\n### DUPLICACIÓN Y DESORGANIZACIÓN DE ARCHIVOS**\n**Problema:**\n- Los 4 zips tienen **contenido superpuesto** (mismo `server.ts`, mismos catálogos, mismo organigrama en distintos formatos).\n- **`agentes.zip`** y **`clientum-agentes.zip`** tienen **dos estructuras distintas** para lo mismo.\n\n**Estructuras encontradas:**\n| **Zip** | **Estructura** | **Ejemplo** |\n|---------|---------------|-------------|\n| `agentes.zip` | **Fichas planas** | `fichas/ventas/santi-sdr.md` |\n| `clientum-agentes.zip` | **Carpetas por rol** | `ventas/santi-sdr/identidad.md`, `memoria.md`, `proceso.md`, `skill.md` |\n\n**🔴 Conflicto:**\n- El script `run-agentes.mjs` (en `agentes.zip`) **asume fichas planas** (`fichas/{departamento}/{nombre}.md`).\n- Pero `clientum-agentes.zip` usa **carpetas con 4 archivos por agente**.\n- **Resultado:** El script **no funcionará** con la estructura de `clientum-agentes.zip`.\n\n---\n\n### **📌 2. INCONSISTENCIAS EN NOMBRES DE AGENTES**\n**Problema:**\nHay **3 formas distintas** de referirse al mismo agente:\n\n| **Roster (YAML)** | **Ficha (agentes.zip)** | **Carpeta (clientum-agentes.zip)** |\n|-------------------|------------------------|--------------------------------------|\n| `customer-success/asesor` | `customer-success-asesor.md` | `customer-success/asesor-comercial-ia/` |\n| `ventas/santi-sdr` | `ventas/santi-sdr.md` | `ventas/santi-sdr/` |\n| `marketing/coordinador` | `marketing/coordinador.md` | `marketing/coordinador-ia/` |\n\n**🔴 Conflicto:**\n- El script `run-agentes.mjs` usa el **roster YAML** para generar el `slug` (ej: `customer-success/asesor` → `customer-success-asesor`).\n- Pero en `clientum-agentes.zip`, las carpetas tienen nombres como `asesor-comercial-ia`.\n- **Resultado:** El script **no encontrará los archivos** de los agentes.\n\n---\n\n### **📌 3. SCRIPTS DUPLICADOS Y DESACTUALIZADOS**\n**Problema:**\nHay **2 versiones de `run-agentes.mjs`** con diferencias críticas:\n\n| **Versión** | **Ubicación** | **Problema** |\n|-------------|---------------|--------------|\n| **Versión 1** | `docs/referencia-tecnica/agentes/scripts/run-agentes.mjs` | **Referenciada en el README** |\n| **Versión 2** | `scripts/run-agentes.mjs` | **Referenciada en el workflow de GitHub** |\n\n**Diferencias clave:**\n1. **Ruta de ejecución:**\n   - Versión 1: Usa `path.join(process.cwd(), 'docs', 'referencia-tecnica', 'agentes')`\n   - Versión 2: Usa `path.join(__dirname, '..', '..', '..')` (asume que está en la raíz)\n\n2. **Node.js requerido:**\n   - Versión 1: Node 20+\n   - Versión 2: Node 22+\n\n3. **Workflow de GitHub:**\n   - Un workflow usa `node scripts/run-agentes.mjs`\n   - Otro usa `node docs/referencia-tecnica/agentes/scripts/run-agentes.mjs`\n   - **🔴 Solo uno funcionará** dependiendo de dónde esté el script.\n\n**🔴 Conflicto:**\n- Si el script está en `docs/...`, el workflow que usa `scripts/run-agentes.mjs` **fallará**.\n- Si el script está en `scripts/`, el workflow que usa `docs/...` **fallará**.\n\n---\n\n### **📌 4. EL SCRIPT NO EJECUTA ACCIONES REALES**\n**Problema:**\nSegún el análisis, el script `run-agentes.mjs` **solo simula respuestas de texto** de Gemini, pero **no ejecuta acciones reales**:\n```javascript\n// Ejemplo del código actual:\nconst response = await gemini.generateContent(prompt);\nconsole.log(`[${agent}] ${response.text}`);\n```\n- **No hay integración con APIs externas** (Google Places, Hunter, etc.).\n- **No hay lógica de negocio** (no enriquece leads, no envía emails, etc.).\n- **Solo imprime texto** en la consola.\n\n**🔴 Conflicto:**\n- El sistema de agentes está diseñado para **automatizar el ciclo comercial completo** (prospección, enriquecimiento, negociación, etc.).\n- Pero el script actual **solo simula conversaciones**, no ejecuta las acciones.\n\n---\n\n### **📌 5. FALTAN INTEGRACIONES CON LAS APIs**\n**Problema:**\nEn los documentos de arquitectura, se mencionan **APIs específicas** para cada agente (Google Places, Hunter, Firecrawl, etc.), pero:\n- **No hay código** que llame a estas APIs.\n- **No hay manejo de errores** para fallos en APIs.\n- **No hay reintentos automáticos** (solo hay un `maxRetries` en el contrato, pero no está implementado).\n\n---\n\n### **📌 6. EL SISTEMA DE MEMORIA NO ESTÁ IMPLEMENTADO**\n**Problema:**\n- En `clientum-agentes.zip`, cada agente tiene un archivo `memoria.md`.\n- Pero **no hay lógica** que:\n  - Guarde el contexto entre ejecuciones.\n  - Aprenda de interacciones pasadas.\n  - Comparta memoria entre agentes.\n\n**Ejemplo de `memoria.md` en un agente:**\n```markdown\n## Memoria del Agente\n- Última ejecución: 2026-07-17\n- Leads procesados: 15\n- Errores: 2\n```\n- **No hay estructura** para almacenar esto en una base de datos.\n- **No hay lógica** para actualizarlo automáticamente.\n\n---\n\n---\n\n## **✅ FEEDBACK Y SOLUCIONES PROPUESTAS**\n\n---\n\n### **🟢 1.
